LicensePage.PageDescription: The AIS data displayed on this website is provided by various sources. The licenses for the individual sources are listed below. Please note that the data may be subject to additional terms and conditions imposed by the respective data providers.

AisStream.Description: The license for the AIS data provided by aisstream.io is currently unknown. Please refer to the source for more information.

Pelyr.Description: AIS data from Pelyr (pelyr.com), Pelyr Data Licence 1.1

FintrafficDigitraffic.Description: AIS data from Fintraffic Digitraffic (digitraffic.fi), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

Metadata.title: OpenShips - Live AIS vessel tracking
Metadata.description: OpenShips is a free and open-source platform for live AIS vessel tracking. Track ships in real-time, view vessel details, and explore maritime traffic worldwide.

hero.title: Connecting ports.
hero.description: An open-source collection of seaports around the world. Structured maritime data, geographic information and identifiers — accessible to everyone.

overview.label: Dataset overview
overview.title: A global perspective on maritime infrastructure.
overview.description: SeaPorts provides a structured collection of seaports worldwide, combining essential port information with geographic data. Built for logistics, research and anyone working with maritime information.

global.title: Global coverage
global.description: A collection of seaports from around the world.

boundaries.title: Port boundaries
boundaries.description: Geographic polygon data for supported ports.

coverage.label: Geographic coverage
coverage.title: From local coastlines to a global network.
coverage.description: The dataset contains port names, identifiers and geographic coordinates worldwide. Detailed geographic boundaries are currently available for ports in Northern Germany, with further expansion planned.

structure.label: Data structure
structure.title: Structured. Accessible. Open.
structure.description: Each port contains a set of geographic and identifying attributes.
structure.note: Geographic boundaries are not yet available for every port.

current.title: Continuous development
current.description: SeaPorts is a work in progress. Port names, UN/LOCODEs and geographic coordinates are available for ports worldwide. Geographic boundaries are currently defined only for Northern Germany.

disclaimer.title: Data accuracy
disclaimer.description: The dataset is provided as-is. Geographic boundaries are approximate and may not represent actual port areas. Always verify information before using it for critical operational or navigational decisions.

license.label: Open source
license.title: Open data. Shared knowledge.
license.description: The dataset is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. You are free to share and adapt the data with appropriate attribution and indication of changes.

cta.title: Explore the world's seaports.
cta.description: Discover the dataset, inspect the source code and contribute to an open maritime data ecosystem.
